verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents an HTTP API, official client libraries, a Postman collection, an MCP server and llms.txt, but none of these is an official CLI. The only command-line item is `ddtrace-run`, a launcher that wraps an application to enable tracing. It is an adjacent instrumentation feature, not a CLI for working with the Datadog platform, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
